# LUNO Documentation

> Official docs for integrating with LUNO — headless CMS on Cloudflare Workers with MCP for AI coding agents.

This file is for **AI agents and developers** wiring Cursor, Claude Desktop, or custom automation to LUNO. For product overview and pricing, read https://luno.rest/llms.txt first.

## Start here

- [AI Agents Guide (EN)](https://doc.luno.rest/en/api/ai-agents): MCP setup, agent API keys, scopes, llms.txt per site, best practices
- [AI エージェント向けガイド (JA)](https://doc.luno.rest/ja/api/ai-agents): 上記の日本語版
- [Quick Start (EN)](https://doc.luno.rest/en/guide/getting-started): First project in the admin console
- [クイックスタート (JA)](https://doc.luno.rest/ja/guide/getting-started): 管理画面での初期セットアップ

## MCP (Model Context Protocol)

Package: `@luno-cms/mcp` — https://www.npmjs.com/package/@luno-cms/mcp

**Recommended (existing site):**

```bash
cd my-site
npx @luno-cms/mcp setup   # Cursor / Claude Code / Codex
npx @luno-cms/mcp env set-key stg 'sk-agent-…'
npx @luno-cms/mcp env switch stg
```

Keys live in **`.agents/luno/{dev,stg,prod}.env`** (gitignored). Details: [AI Agents Guide](https://doc.luno.rest/en/api/ai-agents).

Alternative (inline env for one-off / Claude Desktop):

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "luno": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@luno-cms/mcp"],
      "env": {
        "LUNO_API_URL": "https://api.luno.rest/admin",
        "LUNO_AGENT_KEY": "sk-agent-xxxxxxxx"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Issue keys in the admin console: **Settings → Agent API Keys** (`https://console.luno.rest/settings/api-keys`).

### Agent key scopes

| Scope | Use for |
|-------|---------|
| `full` (recommended) | Entries + Form Set / Contact / Blueprint |
| `content` | Entries, revisions, publish, media only |
| `schema` | Same as `full` (compat alias) |

### MCP tools

**Content (`content` / `full`):** `get_tenant_schema`, `list_form_sets`, `get_form_set_schema`, `get_public_api_info`, `list_entries`, `get_entry`, `create_entry`, `update_entry`, `list_revisions`, `save_revision`, `publish_revision`, `submit_entry_for_review`, `list_media`, `upload_media`, `list_master_entities`, `get_master_entity`, `list_master_records`, `create_master_record`, `translate_entry_locales`, `search_admin_help`, `get_admin_help_article`, `ask_admin_help`, `get_project_content_locales`, `get_login_branding` (+ login appearance / IP allowlist tools; some need user JWT or Business+)

**Schema (`full` / `schema`):** `apply_form_blueprint`, `validate_master_blueprint`, `apply_master_blueprint`, `apply_builtin_form_template` (support `dryRun: true`), `create_contact_form`, `update_contact_form`

Canonical tool list: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@luno-cms/mcp

## API reference

- [API Overview (EN)](https://doc.luno.rest/en/api/overview): Public / Admin / Agent APIs, auth, errors
- [Public API (EN)](https://doc.luno.rest/en/api/public-api): Read published content (no auth)
- [Webhooks (EN)](https://doc.luno.rest/en/api/webhooks): Publish events with HMAC signatures
- [公開 API (JA)](https://doc.luno.rest/ja/api/public-api): 公開 API 日本語
- [API 概要 (JA)](https://doc.luno.rest/ja/api/overview): 認証・エラーコード

Public API base (recommended): `https://api.luno.rest/public/p/{projectId}/v1`  
Public API base (host): `https://{your-domain}/public/v1`  
Agent API base: `https://api.luno.rest/admin/v1` (Bearer `sk-agent-…`)

## Per-site content discovery

Each LUNO project exposes published content for agents:

```bash
curl https://api.luno.rest/public/v1/llms.txt
# or on the project's public host:
curl https://your-domain.com/public/v1/llms.txt
```
